description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'CreateLeadRequest' used for encapsulating the minimal data required to create a lead. It provides a static method to instantiate this DTO from a PSR-7 HTTP request containing JSON payload.

classes.name: CreateLeadRequest
classes.description: A final class acting as a DTO for lead creation, with properties for last name, email, and company, and a static method to create an instance from an HTTP request.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Creates an instance of CreateLeadRequest from an HTTP request by decoding the JSON payload and extracting required fields.
